name: Isabel Costa
bio:
Isabel's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After a successful career in human resources within the tech industry, a chance encounter with a former racing driver sparked her interest. Intrigued by the high-pressure, team-oriented environment, she transitioned to motorsport, bringing her expertise in talent acquisition and employee relations. She believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. 

At Inter Europol Competition, Isabel is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication. She's particularly adept at identifying potential conflicts and resolving them swiftly, ensuring a harmonious and productive workplace. Her loyalty to the team is unparalleled, making her a trusted confidante and a pillar of stability within the organization.

What sets Isabel apart is her ability to blend traditional HR practices with the unique demands of motorsport. She understands the importance of work-life balance, even within the demanding racing schedule, and constantly seeks ways to improve employee well-being and satisfaction. Her commitment to ethical conduct and fair treatment makes her a respected leader within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Isabel is a well-groomed woman of medium height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong black coffee on her desk.
Leaves handwritten thank-you notes for employees after particularly demanding races.
Secretly keeps a collection of vintage motorsport posters.
